title: PuzzleJAX: A Benchmark for Reasoning and Learning
reasoning: The paper introduces a technical framework and benchmark for evaluating reasoning and planning in agents, including LLMs, using tile-based puzzle games. Although it includes a section on 'Ethical considerations' in the appendix regarding the societal impact of AI and the automation of game design, this does not constitute a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as per the provided instructions.
